Sure i, in terms of ANC, they are very good (probably the best I've tested/used 'til now), but in regards of sound quality, when listening to music, they're still nowhere close to my Sennheiser Momentum 4 wireless headphones. I've tested them both , over the course of 1 week & the Sennheiser (although it has pretty average ANC), the sound quality is incredible in comparison (much warmer, fuller sound, less distortion & the bass much more  on point). Also, the battery life for the Sennheiser is probably the best out there, for a wireless over-the-ear headphone - almost double - around of 55-60 h of real listening (the charging being also very fast). The build quality & fit (at least in my opinion) is also better for the Momentum 4. At the end of the day, it all depends what u want to use them for: if u travel a lot, via plane, or on foot - probably the Sony's are a better choice, but if u want to watch a movie, listen to music while playing on your pc - (my case) - the Sennheiser is the go to wireless headphones ...
